security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Free, open-source toolbox of one-click desktop utilities
bundle.longDescription: Oxbox is a tray app with a collection of small, fast utilities: keep awake, screenshots, checksums, duplicate finder, QR codes, system monitor and more. Offline, no telemetry.
